# awscc_iotsitewise_application (Resource)

Represents an AWS IoT SiteWise application that provides IAM Identity Center based access to a workspace.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the application.
- `workspace_name` (String) The name of the workspace that the application belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the application.
- `idc_instance_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM Identity Center instance used to create the application.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) The unique identifier of the application.
- `arn` (String) The ARN of the application.
- `created_at` (String) The time the application was created.
- `dns_subdomain` (String) The DNS-compliant subdomain label assigned to the application.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `idc_application_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM Identity Center application created for the application.
- `status` (String) The current status of the application.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the application was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iotsitewise_application.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the application

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iotsitewise_application.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_iotsitewise_application.example "arn"
```
